ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Works

ModMetaData.description: Two careers: Builder (Labourer, Journeyman, then Mason, Carpenter or Engineer) and Miner (Labourer, Journeyman, then Prospector, Quarryman or Tunneller). Experience comes from the game's own construction, repair, smoothing and mining work. Early draft: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
